notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Gargantuan on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Quicksilver Gargantuan do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Quicksilver Gargantuan.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Quicksilver Gargantuan.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
